claim.claim-text: a digital camera positioned on the housing, the digital camera being configured to capture images of an object or scene in a field of view thereof, the images being transferrable locally to a memory configured to store the images, or being transferrable externally to a computing device configured to store the images or display the images on a display device, and a second control component that is distinct from the first control component, and configured to control operation of the digital camera.
2. The aerosol delivery device of claim 1, wherein the digital camera configured to capture images includes the digital camera configured to selectively capture still images or video.
3. The aerosol delivery device of claim 1 or 2, wherein the second control component is embodied as a system-on-chip (SoC).

4. The aerosol delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the second control component is operatively coupled to a user interface comprising a user input interface and a user output interface, and optionally: wherein the user input interface is configured to receive input in the form of sensor data.

5. The aerosol delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the camera system further includes a communication interface configured to enable wireless transfer of the images to the computing device, and optionally: wherein the communication interface is further configured to enable wireless control of the digital camera from the computing device or another computing device.

6. The aerosol delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the camera system further includes a digital signal processor (DSP) configured to encode the images or video and thereby produce encoded images or videos that are transferrable locally to the memory, or transferrable externally to the computing device.

7. The aerosol delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the camera system further includes an audio encoder configured to encode audio and thereby produce encoded audio that is transferrable locally to the memory, or transferrable externally to the computing device.
8. A control body for an aerosol delivery device, the control body comprising:

a digital camera positioned on the housing, the digital camera being configured to capture images of an object or scene in a field of view thereof, the images being transferrable locally to a memory configured to store the images, or being transferrable externally to a computing device configured to store the images or display the images on a display device, and a second control component that is distinct from the first control component, and configured to control operation of the digital camera.
9. The control body of claim 8, wherein the digital camera configured to capture images includes the digital camera configured to selectively capture still images or video.
10. The control body of claim 8 or 9, wherein the second control component is embodied as a system-on-chip (SoC).

11. The control body of any one of claims 8 to 10, wherein the second control component is operatively coupled to a user interface comprising a user input interface and a user output interface, and optionally: wherein the user input interface is configured to receive input in the form of sensor data.

12. The control body of any one of claims 8 to 11, wherein the camera system further includes a communication interface configured to enable wireless transfer of the images to the computing device, and optionally: wherein the communication interface is further configured to enable wireless control of the digital camera from the computing device or another computing device.

13. The control body of any one of claims 8 to 12, wherein the camera system further includes a digital signal processor (DSP) configured to encode the images or videos and thereby produce encoded images or videos that are transferrable locally to the memory, or transferrable externally to the computing device.

14. The control body of any one of claims 8 to 13, wherein the camera system further includes an audio encoder configured to encode audio and thereby produce encoded audio that is transferrable locally to the memory, or transferrable externally to the computing device.
